scope: J2015.5 blind IDs frozen before spectroscopy. One-to-one without replacement within core and single/multiple-run category. Calipers: 0.5 deg, 0.20 mag r, 0.50 g-i, 0.70 log(1+NSC span), 2 yr joint span, 0.20 leverage, 0.20 class_star. Match uses no PM or error outcomes. Neighbor distance proxies crowding in retrieved SDSS detections, not an image blend truth. r subsets reuse exactly the selected source r detections; fit-only gate exits do not reproduce upstream r association. Differences remain conditional and can reflect unobserved selection.
